page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s3.large is an x86_64 architecture virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 4 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 4 physical cores with a single thread per core configuration. The instance is equipped with 8.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. There is no local NVMe or SSD storage bundled with this instance, requiring external block storage volumes for persistent data. Additionally, it does not include any GPU accelerators or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Operating with dedicated CPU allocation, the ecs.s3.large ensures consistent processing capabilities without the performance variability associated with shared-core or burstable instances. The 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio positions this instance as a lean compute resource. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the lack of bundled local storage and integrated GPUs minimizes overhead, making it a resource-dense option for workloads that require dedicated CPU cycles but have modest memory and storage footprints. Appropriate workloads include lightweight web serving, distributed compute nodes, microservices, and basic batch processing pipelines.
